difficulty: The bug only shows under concurrency: two await get(key) calls in the same tick both miss the cache, so caching the resolved value is too late and the in-flight promise itself has to be stored.
prompt: Our cache in src/cache.js fetches the same key more than once when two callers await get(key) at the same time. Make concurrent get() calls share a single in-flight fetch, so each key is fetched exactly once, and leave the sequential behaviour alone.
reference: Stores the in-flight promise in the map so later concurrent get() calls for the same key return that promise instead of starting a new fetch.
